title: Hum Sab Hai Hussaini (A.S)
body:
Rahe Haq Pe Dekho
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq Ka Parcham Thame Hain
Batil Se Takraye Hain
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Sab Ki Zuba'n Pe Dekho
Naam e Haider Hai (2)
Jazba e Shabbiri Sab Ke Andar Hai (2)
Hum Na Kisi Se Darte Hain
Jo Haq Hai Wo Kehte hain
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Maah e Moharram aaya gham ki ghata chhai
Majlis matam ki har ghar se sada aai
Bibi se ye waada hye
majlis o maatam karna hye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haq Ki Khatir Hum Sab Jaan Luta Denge
Naam e Mola Per Hum Sar Ko Kata Denge
Khoon Ki Taharat Kehti hai
Jaan Amanat Inki Hai
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini (2)
-
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saya Figan Hai Apne Sar Pe Alam Gazi Ka
Khas Hai Har Momin Pe Dekho Karam Gazi Ka
-
Jab Ye Alam Lehrata hai
Dushman Bhi Ghabrata hai
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini 2
-
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Sirat e Shabbiri Per Chalte Rehna hai
Mushkil Jo Bhi Aaye Hans Kar Sehna hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Himmat Har Dam Karna hai
Sabir Humko Banna hai
Hum sab hai Hussaini
<<DIVIDER>>
6. jo bhi yazidi hai Wo Bach Nhi Payega
Aag Me Dozakh Ki Wo Bheja Jayega
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Bhi Yazidi Hai Sunle
Roze Qayamat Yaad Rakhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shayar e Aale Ahemad Nasir Agha hai
Apne Kalam Se Haq Ki Baate'n Likhta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shero Me Sachcai Hai
Izzat Isne Payi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum Sab Hain Hussaini
